notes.title: Flap Demon is going free!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to announce that I plan on making Flap Demon free to play. Looking back, I feel this game does not meet the quality standards of a paid title. I considered removing the title from Steam altogether, but I felt this would be unfair to the previous owners.  

Previous owners will not be affected by this change, and will still retain access to the game.

This change will occur roughly 1 week after this announcement. 

I wanted to personally thank everyone that supported the project up till now, and I hope you will continue to support my other titles. 

Thank you. 
∇
